name: QJB-95 LSW
description:
The QJB-95 LSW, formerly known as the QBB-95, is an LMG variant of the QBZ-95 characterized by the longer, heavier barrel and the addition of a bipod.

The gun also uses a heavier 5.8x42mm round with improved ballistics and penetration compared to the standard ones used in the QBZ-95.

Community submitted model.
